description: Tucked inside the gated Creekside Community, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a comfortable layout designed for everyday living. Vaulted ceilings and natural light create an inviting atmosphere in the main living area, while ceiling fans throughout add year-round comfort. The kitchen features a gas stove, new dishwasher, new microwave, abundant cabinetry, and generous pantry storage, offering both functionality and convenience.    Fresh interior paint gives the home a clean, refreshed feel, and the spacious backyard provides plenty of room to unwind, entertain, garden or personalize your outdoor space. All bedrooms are located upstairs for added privacy, including the primary suite with laminate flooring. Additional highlights include tile flooring downstairs, a 2-car garage, and access to the community park and playground. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, schools, and commuter routes.
